skill.name: gmail-tools
skill.description: Use Gmail through IMAP and SMTP with credentials retrieved from a named 1Password item.
skill.summary: List, read, and reply to Gmail messages using local 1Password credentials.
skill.author: ClementWalter

security_audit.summary: The script findings confirm sensitive Gmail credential access through 1Password, private mailbox reads through IMAP, and outbound email sending through SMTP. Most SKILL.md backtick findings are false positives from Markdown examples, but the skill still has high-impact email and attachment capabilities.

remediation.issue: The skill retrieves Gmail credentials from 1Password and uses them for IMAP and SMTP.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before credential access. Consider OAuth with limited scopes instead of long-lived app passwords.

remediation.issue: Replies can be sent immediately when dry-run is not selected.
remediation.suggestion: Make preview mode the default and require a second explicit confirmation before SMTP delivery.

remediation.issue: Attachment paths are opened and sent with no allowlist or size control.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict attachment directories, show file names and sizes, and require approval before sending files.

remediation.issue: Full email bodies can be printed into the tool output.
remediation.suggestion: Redact or summarize content by default. Add an explicit full-content mode for sensitive messages.

remediation.issue: The subprocess call to 1Password has no timeout and exposes raw stderr in errors.
remediation.suggestion: Add a timeout, sanitize error messages, and keep command arguments as a fixed argv list.

semantic_findings.title: Unconfirmed Email Sending Path
semantic_findings.description: The reply script sends through Gmail SMTP when dry-run is not used. There is no built-in confirmation gate before delivery.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code has a dry-run branch, then sends the reply immediately in the else branch. This creates a clear risk of unintended outbound mail if an agent calls it directly.

semantic_findings.title: Arbitrary Local File Attachment Sending
semantic_findings.description: The reply workflow reads each provided attachment path and sends the file with the email. This can disclose local files if paths are chosen incorrectly.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code checks os.path.exists, opens each path in binary mode, and attaches the content. The documentation also exposes attachment path parameters.

semantic_findings.title: Full Email Content Exposed to Tool Output
semantic_findings.description: The read script extracts the full message body and prints it unless JSON output is selected. Private email content can enter the AI tool transcript.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script decodes text/plain or text/html content into body and prints body to stdout. This is expected functionality, but it is a privacy exposure.

content.value_statement: Gmail work often requires context from current messages and careful replies. This skill lets AI tools list, read, and reply through Gmail using 1Password credentials.
actual_capabilities: Lists recent Gmail messages from a selected folder through IMAP.
Reads message headers and body content by Gmail message ID.
Sends threaded Gmail replies through SMTP with proper reply headers.
Adds optional local file attachments to reply messages.
Retrieves Gmail app credentials from a named 1Password item.
limitations: Requires the local 1Password CLI and an accessible Gmail app password.
Requires Gmail IMAP and SMTP access to be enabled for the account.
The provided files do not include the MCP server implementation described in documentation.
Reply sending can expose account data or attachments without careful review.

use_cases.title: Review Support Mail
use_cases.description: List and read recent customer messages before preparing a response.

use_cases.title: Follow Up on Threads
use_cases.description: Send a threaded reply that keeps Gmail conversation history intact.

use_cases.title: Build Personal Email Workflows
use_cases.description: Connect Gmail access to an AI coding environment for controlled inbox tasks.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gmail-tools to list my 10 most recent Gmail messages from INBOX. Show sender, subject, date, and message ID.

prompt_templates.title: Read One Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gmail-tools to read message ID 46 from INBOX. Summarize the sender, subject, date, and main request.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Threaded Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gmail-tools to prepare a dry-run reply to message ID 46. Keep the thread headers and include the proposed body for review.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Reply with Attachment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gmail-tools to reply to message ID 46 with my approved response and attach the specified file. Confirm recipient and attachment first.

output_examples.input: List my five newest inbox messages.
output_examples.output: A concise message list with sender, subject, date, and Gmail message ID for each email.
A plain-language summary of the message, including sender, topic, date, and requested action.
A preview showing recipient, subject, thread headers, attachment names, and the reply body before sending.

best_practices: Use dry-run mode and review every reply before sending email.
Store only a Gmail app password in the dedicated 1Password item.
Review recipient, body, and attachment names before allowing SMTP sending.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the AI tool to send email without human approval.
Do not attach broad folders or sensitive files to reply messages.
Do not use a personal app password in a shared automation environment.

faq.question: Does this skill store my Gmail password?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves credentials from a local 1Password item at runtime.

faq.question: Can it send email?
faq.answer: Yes. The reply script sends through Gmail SMTP and supports a dry-run preview.

faq.question: Does it require a Gmail app password?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation expects a Gmail app password stored in 1Password.

faq.question: Can it search Gmail?
faq.answer: The documentation describes IMAP search. The provided standalone scripts cover list, read, and reply.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this safe for automatic use?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill can access private email and send replies as the Gmail account.
